system.description:
When an ally within Close range rolls a failure with Fear, spend an Echo to subtly change the flow of fate. Choose one of the following options:

  • The ally gains a Hope.

  • The GM cannot make a GM move in response to the roll.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v1.0 Heart

system.gmNotes: Spend Echo from the class feature that holds it: the system can only charge a cost to the resource on the same item, so this Echo cost is paid by hand.
